review_notes: I read all 58 lines of PlanarPositive.lean and inspected the directly relevant sources PlanarGinibre.lean, IsingPositive.lean, and FerromagneticMean.lean, plus repository-wide searches for the antipode/mean machinery. The file has four substantive declarations: an antipode-existence construction, a cosine antipode identity, a single symmetry argument for reference-mean nonnegativity, and a thin application of edgeMean_nonneg. Each helper is used exactly once, and planar_reference_mean_nonneg contains the only instance of the translation/odd-integrand averaging argument. The analogous Ising result uses a different product-moment argument, and planar_edge_mean_nonneg is a short wrapper around the existing generic edgeMean_nonneg rather than repeated mathematical reasoning. I found no nontrivial proof block repeated in at least two proofs in this file or a directly related proof, so I did not manufacture a shared-lemma finding.
